import sys

def ReFormatString(S, K):
    # Remove all existing dashes and convert to uppercase
    filtered = [c.upper() for c in S if c != '-']
    n = len(filtered)
    result = []
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        # Determine the length of the current group
        if i == 0:
            # First group can be shorter than K but at least 1
            group_len = min(K, n - i)
        else:
            group_len = K
        # Add the group to the result
        result.append(''.join(filtered[i:i+group_len]))
        i += group_len
        # Add dash if not the last group
        if i < n:
            result.append('-')
    return ''.join(result)

def main():
    S = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    K = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    print(ReFormatString(S, K))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
